name: scope
title: Scope
description: RAII-style **acquire → use → release** with guaranteed cleanup. Optionally run `acquire` first (binding its result to `bind`, so `body` and `finally` can name the resource), then run `body`; `finally` **always** runs afterward — on normal completion, an early `return`, or an error — so a lock is freed / a handle closed / a temp removed no matter how the body exits. The body's result, `return`, or error then propagates; a `finally` failure surfaces only when the body itself succeeded (it never masks the body's own error). If `acquire` errors the resource was never taken, so `finally` does not run. The deterministic resource-lifecycle guard-rail (RAII for flows).
